body.message: The 1BR is available from July 1 at AED 6,500/month, fixed for the first 3 months. Months 4 to 6 are reviewed based on market conditions, so that rate isn't locked in upfront. No video is available, but the listing has a full photo gallery here: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-dubai-hills-estate-executive-residences-executive-residences-2-69093988.html, would you like to come see it in person?
